subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should maintainers close this protected stale PR as superseded by current main's official Vertex SDK 0.19 dependency repair, or sponsor a refreshed local-client replacement?
rationale: The maintainer and human-review labels block automated cleanup, and the remaining choice is an auth-provider ownership decision rather than a safe mechanical repair.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Close this PR after linking the current-main provider SDK 0.19 update and keep any release/live-proof follow-up on the canonical Anthropic Vertex issue.

options.title: Sponsor A Refresh
options.body: Ask for a new current-main branch that preserves the cache-control invariant, declares provider-owned dependencies and shrinkwrap, and proves a live Node 25+/26 Vertex ADC turn.

options.title: Keep Waiting
options.body: Leave this dirty branch open without action, accepting continued review noise and no clear merge path.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after linking the current-main provider SDK 0.19 update and keep any release/live-proof follow-up on the canonical Anthropic Vertex issue.
